name: InputRichMessage
description: Describes a rich message to be sent. Exactly **one** of the fields _html_, _markdown_, or _blocks_ must be used.

fields.name: blocks
fields.description: Content of the rich message to send described as a list of blocks

fields.name: html
fields.description: Content of the rich message to send described using HTML formatting. See [rich message formatting options](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#rich-message-formatting-options) for more details. Use _media_ field to specify the media used in the message.

fields.name: markdown
fields.description: Content of the rich message to send described using Markdown formatting. See [rich message formatting options](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#rich-message-formatting-options) for more details. Use _media_ field to specify the media used in the message.

fields.name: media
fields.description: List of media that are specified in the _markdown_ or _html_ fields using `tg://photo?id=`, `tg://video?id=`, `tg://document?id=`, and `tg://audio?id=` links

fields.name: is_rtl
fields.description: Pass _True_ if the rich message must be shown right-to-left

fields.name: skip_entity_detection
fields.description: Pass _True_ to skip automatic detection of entities (e.g., URLs, email addresses, username mentions, hashtags, cashtags, bot commands, or phone numbers) in the text
